resource_prerequisite: Existing user render-blender.service cgroup, CPUWeight=20 and CPUQuota<=300%, checked before each invocation. Runner enters that cgroup before launching Blender and pins its entire process tree to two CPUs. Render only one Blender process at a time; coordinate shared renderer slot.
assets: Original reference head .blend, supplied skin, official bookshelf/oak-planks textures and vanilla model JSON are preserved under assets/. Every output .blend packs all three textures and embeds its entrypoint plus scene.py.
script_commit_policy: Scripts are saved and hashed, not committed. Explicit parent directive: no commits and no .git anywhere in the portfolio tree.
geometry_policy: Exact reference base/outer head mesh and UVs, with uniform per-arrangement scaling only; NMSR camera-relative orientation unchanged. Bookshelves remain whole vanilla cubes. No shelf recesses, stretched head volumes, sculpted books, bevels or substitute textures.
display_audio_gpu: No display server, audio sink, game runtime or GPU allocated. DISPLAY/WAYLAND_DISPLAY removed; CPU Cycles and -noaudio; CUDA/HIP/ROCR device visibility empty.
